baseline_models.focus_anchor: The alerting أَرَءَيْتَ opens a report whose doubled ن س ي is opposed by أَنْ أَذْكُرَهُ.
baseline_models.mechanism: A spoken disclosure brings an absent event back into shared attention. The explicit agent in the exceptive clause makes the lapse an interruption of recall, while ذ ك ر marks the recovery that the report now performs.

activation_trace.role: Producing speech by articulation supplies the public act that restores the absent event.
The alerting and inform-me use frames what follows as a disclosure demanding attention.
Loss of a remembered item supplies the lapse that the utterance reverses.
The rebellious agent supplies the text's named blocker rather than leaving the lapse causally blank.
Bringing something back after forgetting supplies the repaired endpoint of the memory sequence.

changed_reading.before: The speaker merely reports an ordinary lapse concerning the fish.
changed_reading.after: The utterance is recovered testimony: it identifies an obstructed memory channel and repairs it by voicing the event.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: أَوَيْنَا إِلَى ٱلصَّخْرَةِ is answered by the fish's وَٱتَّخَذَ سَبِيلَهُ فِى ٱلْبَحْرِ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The humans gather at a hard, stable refuge, while the aquatic creature actively makes a traversable way into wide water. The same point is therefore both a place of shelter and an exit threshold.

activation_trace.role: Joining a gathering and sheltering direction supplies the stationary human pole of the event.
The great hard rock gives the refuge material solidity and fixes the threshold.
The fish branch fixes the moving subject as an aquatic creature crossing away from the refuge.
Making or acquiring something for oneself supplies the fish's active formation of its route.
An extended way that can be traveled turns disappearance into legible movement.
Abundant open water supplies the mobile expanse opposed to the rock's solidity.

changed_reading.before: The rock and sea are successive geographical details in a recollection.
changed_reading.after: The rock is a hinge where sheltered solidity opens into a self-made route through mobile water.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: أَرَءَيْتَ and عَجَبًا bracket the account of the fish's path.
baseline_models.mechanism: Directed attention precedes a route whose unfamiliarity and unknown cause produce wonder. The affect is therefore also an epistemic marker: this movement is not yet assimilated to ordinary explanation.

activation_trace.role: Seeing by eye or insight supplies the demand to attend to the event.
A traversable extended path gives the strange event a coherent object rather than diffuse amazement.
Wonder at an unfamiliar or unexplained event marks the route as interpretively unfinished.

changed_reading.before: عَجَبًا is an affective flourish attached to an unusual disappearance.
changed_reading.after: Wonder flags the route as an anomaly whose cause and significance remain open for further reading.

context_deltas.mechanism: The travelers intend to reach a joining point, arrive without recognizing it, pass beyond it, and then treat the recalled fish-event as exactly what they sought. Return and stepwise trace-following convert the fish's strange route from spectacle into waypoint evidence.

activation_trace.role: Reaching a limit or goal establishes the journey's intended arrival condition.
Gathering separated things into one supplies the confluence at which the sign occurs.
A descending passage or burrow gives the fish-route the shape of an entrance left at the junction.
Crossing and passing through a place supplies the overshoot that makes recall consequential.
Seeking a thing turns the recalled anomaly into the criterion that identifies the goal.
Returning something to its prior place supplies the travel reversal caused by recognition.
Following after a predecessor supplies the retraceable line back toward the missed point.
Tracking an أثر step by step turns the prior journey into navigable evidence.

structural_cues: 18:60 sets the destination, 18:61 records unrecognized arrival, 18:62 marks overshoot, 18:63 supplies recalled testimony, and 18:64 reverses travel.
18:61 first narrates the fish, path, and sea externally; 18:63 reconstructs the same event as belated speech.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies destination, arrival, overshoot, recollection, seeking, return, and trace-following; I infer the arrow recalled anomaly -> waypoint recognition. A live alternative is that the fish-event merely coincides with the waypoint rather than functioning as an intentional sign.

changed_reading.before: The fish's path is a marvelous incident remembered after a rest.
changed_reading.after: The remembered path is operational evidence: it identifies the missed destination and reverses an overshot journey.

context_deltas.mechanism: Retracing the route leads immediately to finding a bearer of disclosed knowledge; following him is requested for right guidance. Patience is then tied to incomplete encompassing knowledge, and mention is deferred until the guide initiates it. The focus route thus becomes entry into a discipline of following and delayed disclosure.

activation_trace.role: Finding and encountering supplies the immediate result of returning along the route.
Disclosure of a thing to a knower supplies the epistemic destination beyond the geographical one.
Following أثر after أثر converts route recovery into a requested mode of learning.
Straightness of path and guidance makes the desired knowledge explicitly directional.
Complete encompassing in knowledge supplies the missing capacity that makes appearances hard to bear.
Knowledge of the inner aspect of a matter supplies what the learner does not yet possess.
A reminder that makes something present supplies the guide-controlled moment of later disclosure.

structural_cues: The retracing of 18:64 is immediately followed by finding in 18:65 and a request to follow in 18:66.
18:68 contrasts patience with incomplete encompassing knowledge, while 18:70 postpones mention until the guide initiates it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the sequence route -> finding -> following -> guidance and the rule of deferred mention; I infer that the fish-sign initiates an epistemic apprenticeship, not just a relocation. The live alternative is the narrower reading that it only locates the encounter.

changed_reading.before: The fish route solves a problem of physical location.
changed_reading.after: The route opens a guided knowledge process in which one must follow before causes are disclosed.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus combines forgetting with the fish taking a path; 18:73 recombines the same roots as taking a person to account for what he forgot. Added burden and difficulty make cognitive lapse an ethical relation between companions, not only a private failure of memory.

activation_trace.role: Holding someone accountable for a fault supplies the interpersonal consequence attached to forgetting.
Loss of remembrance repeats the focus lapse inside an explicit plea about blame.
Imposing what weighs heavily supplies the feared effect of punitive treatment.
Difficulty and severity supply the journey-level cost of turning lapse into burden.

structural_cues: 18:63 places ن س ي and ء خ ذ in the fish report; 18:73 places them together again in تُؤَاخِذْنِى بِمَا نَسِيتُ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a later grammatical recombination of the same roots with burden and difficulty; I infer an accountability lens on the earlier confession. This does not make the speakers identical or prove equal culpability.

changed_reading.before: The focus lapse explains why information arrived late.
changed_reading.after: The lapse also anticipates a question of forbearance: whether forgetting will be converted into blame that burdens companionship.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later lesson separates visible action from inner knowledge and from the outcome to which an action returns. Announcement of that outcome is delayed until after patience fails. The focus wonder becomes the first compact instance of a narrative rule: anomalous appearance should remain open pending disclosure.

activation_trace.role: Complete epistemic enclosure names the missing frame needed to judge an anomalous appearance.
Knowledge of a matter's interior supplies the hidden side withheld from immediate perception.
A report that comes and is conveyed supplies the promised explanatory disclosure.
Returning a thing to its outcome supplies the endpoint from which the strange acts become readable.
Holding oneself from agitation supplies the temporal capacity required before explanation.
The repeated return to outcome closes the delayed-explanation structure announced at separation.

structural_cues: The outwardly objectionable acts in 18:71, 18:74, and 18:77 precede their explanations in 18:79-82.
The focus labels its anomalous movement عَجَبًا before the later discourse explicitly distinguishes appearance, inner knowledge, patience, and outcome.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies unknown inner knowledge, delayed report, patience, and repeated outcome-language; I infer that focus wonder prefigures this pedagogy of suspended judgment. A live alternative is that the fish marvel only marks the meeting place and does not model the later acts.

changed_reading.before: Wonder registers a marvelous event whose oddity is complete in itself.
changed_reading.after: Wonder marks an appearance that should be carried without premature closure until its knowledge and outcome become available.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus fish makes a way for itself in the sea, whereas the later king takes every ship in the sea by force. Repetition of ء خ ذ inside one maritime frame sets self-directed routing against coercive capture.

activation_trace.role: Making or acquiring something for oneself supplies the fish's self-directed taking of a route.
The ship that cleaves the water supplies the vulnerable maritime traveler in the later scene.
The same abundant water-space holds both free route-making and threatened seizure.
Royal sovereignty supplies the organized power behind the contrary mode of taking.
Seizing and capture supply the king's coercive taking of vessels.
Taking property unjustly by force fixes the later action as domination rather than route-making.

structural_cues: 18:63 and 18:79 repeat ء خ ذ and ب ح ر around an aquatic mover, but assign the taking to opposite agencies and objects.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated root, sea setting, self-acquired route, royal seizure, and force; I infer a formal contrast between mobile freedom and appropriation. This need not mean that the fish escapes the king or shares the ship episode's plot.

changed_reading.before: The fish's taking a path is only a description of locomotion.
changed_reading.after: Within the later maritime echo, it becomes an exploratory counterimage of movement that makes its own way rather than being forcibly taken.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the packet's non-dominant ر و ي mapping beneath QAC ر ء ي. It remains anchored at focus word 2 and in the act of reporting the water-event; render it only as a form-distant resonance, never as a replacement for the ordinary force of أَرَءَيْتَ.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: أَرَءَيْتَ initiates the transfer of the remembered event from one speaker to another.

activation_trace.role: Transmission of report or verse supplies a relay image in which the water-event is carried into narration.

changed_reading.before: أَرَءَيْتَ functions only as an attention-directing formula.
changed_reading.after: As a qualified split-root echo, it also makes the utterance a relay that carries the recovered event onward as report.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The move is surprising because it activates an affective branch of ب ح ر inside a plainly literal sea. It remains anchored by the adjacency of ٱلْبَحْرِ and عَجَبًا; render it as a spatial-affective overlay, not as a claim that sea lexically means wonder here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: فِى ٱلْبَحْرِ عَجَبًا places the sea root immediately beside explicit wonder.

activation_trace.role: The sea-root's bewilderment branch overlays the literal water with the observer's disorientation.
Wonder at an unfamiliar or unexplained event makes that affective overlay explicit.

changed_reading.before: The sea is only the physical medium, and wonder comments externally on the route.
changed_reading.after: The route traverses both water and bewilderment, making the sea a qualified spatial-affective medium.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This material analogy is surprising because it links the focus rock to the later wall without a shared root. It remains anchored in the named solid landmark, delayed recollection, and the packet's wall-treasure-emergence sequence; render it as a structural analogy, not as a claim that the rock contains treasure.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: إِذْ أَوَيْنَا إِلَى ٱلصَّخْرَةِ names a solid landmark where the sign is present but its significance is delayed.

activation_trace.role: The great hard rock supplies the first solid threshold associated with delayed recognition.
The raised wall supplies a later solid structure whose visible condition conceals its preservative function.
Stored and protected wealth supplies what the later solid threshold preserves through delay.
Reaching the appointed limit supplies the maturity condition that ends the delay.
Bringing something out of concealment supplies the eventual disclosure side of the analogy.

changed_reading.before: The rock is an incidental landmark at which the fish-event happened.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material analogy, the rock is the first solid threshold at which a sign is held through delay before it can direct action.

strongest_changes: The fish's marvelous route becomes the missed waypoint that reverses an overshot journey and leads into guided knowledge.
Forgetting shifts from a private lapse to recovered testimony, then to an accountability problem when ء خ ذ and ن س ي recur in 18:73.
Wonder becomes a marker for appearances whose inner knowledge and outcome are deferred.
summary.what_was_special: The tightest activation was mechanical rather than merely thematic: arrival, forgetting, overshoot, recollection, reversal, tracking, finding, following, and delayed explanation form one route-and-knowledge chain around 18:63.
remaining_uncertainties: The text does not state that the fish intended to signal the destination; that causal arrow remains reader-supplied.
The maritime contrast between a self-routing fish and forcibly taken ships is a formal echo, not a claim of shared plot agency.
The split-root and rock-wall readings should remain qualified resonances.
